unusual_experiment.name: RELOCATED_UNICODE_READONLY_FOREIGN_CWD
unusual_experiment.baseline: Exact prior EntityOS artifact self-test from ordinary writable working directory.
unusual_experiment.intervention: Copy the exact artifact into a Unicode temporary path, make its containing directory and a foreign working directory read-only, then run --self-test-json from that foreign working directory.
unusual_experiment.rollback: Temporary experiment tree removed; no persistent EntityOS state modified.
unusual_experiment.counterevidence: The outer container command wrapper reported status 1 after the experiment even though the captured EntityOS exit code was 0 and a follow-up ordinary observation confirmed byte-identical outputs and rollback. Preserve this as a tool-environment anomaly rather than product PASS evidence.

grf_collapse.observed: The current product head builds two bit-identical one-file freezes on the accepted self-hosted Linux/x64 workflow, and the resulting exact EntityOS bytes independently pass the canonical local self-test after artifact download.
grf_collapse.retained_hypothesis: The one-file carrier and build reproducibility boundary are strong enough to remain the release carrier while semantic capability coverage expands.
grf_collapse.counter_reality: Reproducible one-file packaging and self-test success can still coexist with a functionally incomplete Clay Machine.

release_blocker.exact_blocking_invariant: EntityOS itself reports whole_machine_acceptance=false. Current CLAY_MACHINE workspace still lacks the canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime plus String/argv/effect-signature surface needed to drive real process/data semantics through ClayCode -> TypedIR -> single ClayVM -> ClayOS, with broader runtime/network/media obligations still open.
release_blocker.next_executable_step: Select and implement the smallest provenance-bound canonical String/Bytes/argv value and effect-signature slice, drive one real process request through the existing TypedIR/ClayVM/ClayOS path without backend-local request-id semantics, then rebuild the double-freeze EntityOS and rerun exact one-file acceptance gates.
